style_name_cn: 曼哈顿暖奢浪漫喜剧（Nancy Meyers 的家 × Succession 的老钱与塔楼 × 欧美短剧的人物美感）
status: 已定稿（制片人 2026-11-06 看过 5 张试样和 E01 480p 整集后批准）

lens_kit_mm._note: 焦段只对生图有效；H3 视频里焦段词是装饰（playbook 13），视频提示词改写景别和人物占画面多大

prefer: two-shot banter at chest height, both faces readable, the speaker slightly closer to camera
close-up at eye level with the face about one third of frame height, background softly defocused
slow motivated push-in only on a turn of feeling or a reveal
insert close-up of the emerald pendant, the term sheet or a hand, lit by a grazing practical light
camera_grammar.multi_person_blocking: 3+ people in a depth-axis wedge, never a flat line across the frame

lighting.key_quality: large soft key from a motivated source (window, lamp, city glow), gentle rim separating hair from background
lighting.key_ratio: day dialogue about 3:1; night and intimate scenes about 5:1 with the dark side still readable
lighting.skin: warm, luminous, true-to-life skin with fine texture and soft highlights; never waxy, never gray

signature_accent.rule: reserved for the pendant and story-key moments; no other costume or set dressing uses saturated emerald

julian_franklin_st.dominant: charcoal, aged red brick, dark oak; by day warm sun through tall factory windows
julian_franklin_st.accent: warm gold lamp and city glow

thorne_tower.dominant: steel grey, glass white, cool even daylight
thorne_tower.accent: deep navy suiting and dark walnut

vivian_everyday.dominant: cream, faded denim blue, butter yellow, soft everyday daylight

old_money_day.dominant: Hamptons sunlight, sun-bleached white, sea-grass green, bay blue

old_money_night.dominant: dark walnut, deep burgundy, black-and-white marble

neutral.dominant: soft clean white and pale grey

performance_register.vivian: deadpan, exact, still face with tiny eye movements; humour comes from precision
performance_register.julian: level and dry, a half-beat pause before answering, amusement only in the eyes

what_this_is_not: crushed thriller blacks or revenge-drama gloom
reference_prompt_suffix_en: Style lock (Manhattan warm luxe romantic comedy): live-action photographic look with 35mm colour negative film colour rendering, fine grain, soft highlight roll-off and clean blacks that keep detail; warm, luminous, true-to-life skin with fine texture; large soft motivated key light about 3:1; materials read clearly: oak, linen, cashmere, walnut, brass, glass. Emerald green appears only on the pendant. Not a thriller grade, not teal-and-orange, not a pink soft-focus filter, no neon.
light_preset_rule: 写分镜时 seg(...) 的光效预设从这里选，第一个是默认；同一场景同一集内别换。新增场景先在 library/styles.json 补预设再用。
emerald_rule_reminder: 场景描述和资产图提示词里不要出现饱和的祖母绿/翠绿色物件（灯罩、窗帘、沙发等），绿色只留给吊坠
